message.content: {"calls": [], "reason": "The question requires assessing progression and changes across multiple figures (chronology), but the available tools only provide static, single-image interpretations for confirmed chest X-rays. The provided images include CT scans (figures 3a, 3b, 3c) which are ineligible for the CXR classifier, and a single CXR (figure 5) without a paired timepoint to establish change. Invoking tools on a single static image cannot answer questions about progression or comparison across figures. Therefore, no tool calls are made as they would not provide the necessary longitudinal evidence."}
